_comment: dog.c mon_arrive() for a MIGR_PORTAL arrival on a level with no magic portal. Seven flute improvisations leave svc.context.jingle as the single note 'D'; #wizloadlua tut-1 builds the tutorial's portals with dst {-1,-1}, so ledger_no() reads svd.dungeons[-1].ledger_start, which overlays the jingle, and gives ledger 67, Sokoban's second level for this seed. A monster enters a portal during the 100 turns of searching and migrates there with MIGR_PORTAL. The hero level-teleports to Dlvl 2 by number first, so the ^V menu's redraw does not show the tutorial walls whose wall mode 4 makes display.c wall_angle() call impossible(); the menu then picks soko2, losedogs() delivers the monster, and C prints impossible("mon_arrive: no corresponding portal?"). Seed 1034 is the first of 1000-1048 (this character and clock) where the port found both a one-note Sokoban or Vlad's Tower jingle and a portal entry.
